about: The share of each state's voting-eligible population who cannot vote because of a felony conviction, as of the November 2024 election. Read by src/core2/law-reach/group-a-voting.ts felonyDisenfranchisedShare. D.C. and the territories are not in the report: they take the national share (SG-GOV-REACH-A-convictions).
citation: The Sentencing Project, Locked Out 2024: Four Million Denied Voting Rights Due to a Felony Conviction (October 2024), Table 2, 'Estimates of Disenfranchised Americans with Felony Convictions, 2024' (the report's own estimates; percent of the voting-eligible population, the closest measure to the voting-age population it gives). https://www.sentencingproject.org/reports/locked-out-2024-four-million-denied-voting-rights-due-to-a-felony-conviction/
